bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Big weekend of moves in Bears land: Chicago shipped defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr. to the Falcons in exchange for cornerback Clark Phillips III and a 2027 fifth-round pick, wrapping up months of trade speculation. The Bears also trimmed to their initial 53-man roster, with head coach Ben Johnson giving positive signs on Luther Burden's Week 1 outlook even though the rookie sat out Saturday's preseason finale against Tennessee while working through a groin issue. Add in Ozzy Trapilo's remarkable return from a ruptured patellar tendon making the roster, and it's clear Ryan Poles and company are setting the final pieces before the opener in Carolina.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Good morning, Lions fans! Detroit’s roster is officially taking shape after a busy weekend, with the team announcing a wave of cuts and waivers as they trimmed down to 53 — including releasing veteran TE Tyler Conklin and waiving QB Luke Altmyer, among many others.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Big shakeup in Eagan today: the Vikings just traded offensive tackle Walter Rouse to the Patriots and cut ties with both QB Max Brosmer and rookie WR Dillon Bell, signaling the roster isn't done evolving even after finalizing their 53-man group. The real storyline to watch remains J.J. McCarthy's ankle injury, which per Adam Schefter could sideline him for multiple weeks, leaving the backup QB picture behind Kyler Murray murky heading into the opener against Green Bay.
